title: WikiSkill prediction row (schema_version 1)
description: One agent rollout on one task under one condition; one JSON object per line in results/predictions.jsonl.

run.description: run-1, run-2, … for evolution runs; a free label for `eval`.

split.description: val or test for evolution runs; the --split value for `eval`.

condition.description: no-skills | evolved | candidate:<skill>@iter<k> | resumed-skills | <eval set label>

system_prompt_sha256.description: Text is in results/prompts/<sha>.txt (empty string if unknown).

output.description: Full execution log. Lines start with [thinking], [assistant], [tool_use], [tool_result]; the final reply is the text after the last "[final] " marker. An external AI's output needs no markers: the whole text counts as the final reply.

model.description: Optional. Resolved model id that produced the answer (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001); absent for external rows.

created_at.description: Optional. When the row was written; test rows are written after all gate rollouts.

correct_original.description: Added by `wikiskill rescore`: the verdict before the first re-scoring.
